t: Shanghai Mutual Telephone Company employee attack Not Listed

pages.en:
File No. D.4926.
==========

A number of employees of the Shanghai
Mutual Telephone Company were taking tea in a
teashop on Kiukiang Road about 1.30 p.m. May 25,
1933. Three strange Chinese named Ting Ts Nyi
(丁志義), Yu Tsing(俞鈞) and Woo Sz Ong(吳時洪)
came and endeavoured to force one of them named Dien
Foh Yuen(田福元) to go to the Public Safety Bureau.
Dien, however, succeeded in resisting with the aid
of his colleagues. Police came to the scene and
arrested Ting Ts Nyi and Yu Tsing. Both of these
stated that they were employed by one Lu Kuh Ching
(呂克勤), a political official of Nanking who has
offices in the Public Safety Bureau. The case is
at present on remand.
pages.zh:
档案编号 D.4926。
===

1933年5月25日下午约1时30分，上海电话公司（Shanghai Mutual Telephone Company）的数名职员正在九江路的一家茶馆饮茶。三名身份不明的华人丁志義、俞鈞和吳時洪前来，企图强行带走其中一名名为田福元的职员前往公安局。然而，田福元在同事的帮助下成功抗拒。警察赶到现场，逮捕了丁志義和俞鈞。二人均称受雇于呂克勤，此人为南京方面的一名政治官员，在公安局设有办事处。本案目前尚在候审中。
